cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Fair Exchange
cards.instruction: Price every favor in time, effort, inconvenience, or future obligation.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Naturally. The usual arrangement. Half an hour helping you move buys two hours painting my shed on Saturday.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Saturday's my only lie-in. Can I come after lunch?

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly how we always do it. Afternoon painting costs me cricket. Three hours, then.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'll hire a painter. But I need the sofa carried up three flights.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then two painter-hours covers loading; the stairs cost a third. Cricket's free again.

mechanism: A copies a mistaken calculation or exchange custom and confidently uses it to set the price of helping.
confusable: Unlike simple one-upmanship, D46 specifies payment in effort; S04 must cause the pricing mistake.
comparison: Domestic washing bargain versus moving help with competing time commitments.
seedUse: Use the pan-soaking discount and hired painter alternative as partner contributions; replace confidence padding.
